create_timer_cpu: create a Timer instance that measures CPU execution time with a given name
create_timer_cuda: create a Timer instance that measures CUDA execution time with device synchronization
run_timer_context_manager: run a Timer as a context manager to automatically start and stop around a code block
test_timer_elapsed_time: test the elapsed_time property of a Timer to get the measured duration in seconds
review_timer_device_fallback: review the Timer class behavior when falling back from CUDA to CPU device
